bundled.description:
The bundled copy Loadout wrote (the Loadout skill for agents, #8).
Marks the skill as bundled on its own, without `[source]`: 0.5.x
reads an unknown `[source] kind` as an error but keeps this table.

id.description: Skill id; equals the file name. Identity, not the name.

BundledCopy.description:
The copy of a bundled skill Loadout last wrote into the store: content
with another hash was edited by the user and is never updated.

hash.description: `sha256:<hex>` of the content as written (paths and bytes, sorted).

version.description: The Loadout version the content shipped with.

ClientSelection.description: "all-detected" or a list of client ids

DistributionMethod.description: How a skill reaches client skill directories (SPEC 12.2).

clients.description: Client ids, or "all-detected". Unknown ids are a warning and are kept.

catalog.description:
The catalog entry it was installed from, `<catalog>/<entry id>`
(#26).

commit.description: Commit the store copy came from (git).

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit followed for updates (git); a commit pins it.
